description: Find open and upcoming opportunities by jurisdiction, cause area, region and deadline. Ordered by deadline (soonest first, rolling and unknown deadlines last), then name, then slug. Results are not ranked against an organization. Use the slug of a result with opportunity_detail.

cause_area.description: Canonical cause area. Values match the platform taxonomy (core/cra_to_canonical.py, core/ntee_to_canonical.py).

deadline_after.description: Only opportunities with a fixed deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

deadline_before.description: Only opportunities with a fixed deadline on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

include_rolling.description: Include opportunities with rolling or unpublished deadlines. Ignored when a deadline filter is set.

jurisdiction.description: Country of operation or grantmaking (CA or US).

region_code.description: ISO 3166-2 province or state code, for example CA-ON or US-WA. Matches funders and opportunities that serve that region, including national ones.

status.description: Restrict to opportunities that are open now or announced as upcoming. Omit for both.

name: opportunity_search

items.description: Adding a value is a minor contract change; removing or renaming one is a major change (§38.2).

deadline.description: Next fixed deadline. Null when deadline_type is rolling or unknown.

eligibility_summary.description: Plain-language eligibility, not an inferred fit score.

funder_slug.description: Slug for funder_profile, or null when the funder has no public profile.

source_url.description: The funder's own page for this opportunity.

title: Search public opportunities
